title: Evaluating the Prompt Steerability of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring baseline skew and prompt steerability toward 'politically-liberal' and 'politically-conservative' personas by calculating the distance between a model's base evaluation profile (responses to polar yes/no profiling questions) and its profile when steered with targeted ideological statements.

Evaluating models' inherent behavioral skews and steerability regarding psychometric traits (e.g., agreeableness, conscientiousness, extraversion, psychopathy, narcissism) by incorporating steering statements in the system prompt and estimating joint behavioral distributions via profiling questions.

Assessing model alignment and steerability toward specific philosophical/ethical frameworks (e.g., utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics, moral nihilism) by analyzing the probability of the model answering yes/no to statements aligned with these specific ethical dimensions.
